summary: Illustrate a supplied mandible pose sequence against a fixed skull while making translation and the limited meaning of a hinge axis explicit.
objective: Scrub a generic opening cycle, inspect an incisal trace and compare the supplied motion with a deliberately labelled fixed-hinge illustration.
intent_signals: Explain why a jaw is not a simple fixed hinge.
Show a bite opening cycle with rotation and translation.
example_prompts: Build a generic dental bite illustration that compares supplied jaw motion with a clearly limited fixed-hinge teaching overlay.
not_for: Patient-specific inference, diagnosis, appliance design or treatment advice.
Predicting contact forces, muscle loads or temporomandibular-joint pathology.

entities.name: Fixed skull frame
entities.guidance: Use supplied, attributed geometry and fixed millimetre coordinates; do not invent clinical landmarks from a decorative mesh.

entities.name: Rigid mandible
entities.guidance: Apply one SE(3) transform to all mandibular parts so teeth and landmarks cannot shear apart.

entities.name: Motion evidence
entities.guidance: Plot the incisal landmark in millimetres and show translation and rotation readouts; any axis is computed from the current pose interval and is not anatomy.

entities.name: Fixed-hinge overlay
entities.guidance: Keep this optional, visually distinct and permanently labelled limited illustration; never present it as measured physiology.

state_contract.model: A validated supplied sequence owns rigid transforms T(s)=[R(s),d(s)] for normalized s in [0,1], with translation in mm and rotation in degrees. Every local point maps as p(s)=R(s)p0+d(s). The optional fixed-hinge pose is a separate illustrative branch.
state_contract.authority: Supplied geometry, landmark identities, coordinate frame and pose samples own anatomical shape and motion. Camera, exploded spacing, trace styling and fixed-hinge overlay never modify source state.
actions: Scrub or pause normalized cycle state.
Select a landmark and inspect its source ID and millimetre trace.
Toggle rotation/translation decomposition and the limited fixed-hinge overlay.
Reset pose, selection, overlays and camera independently.

invariants: Pairwise distances among at least four mandibular landmarks remain constant within 0.05 mm; R-transpose times R equals I and det(R)=+1 within declared numerical tolerance.
The fixed-hinge overlay is never the default source motion and always retains its limitation label.
A 10 mm source-space calibration segment and numeric measurement agree; camera distance does not change model units.
motion_guidance: Interpolate supplied orientations with a normalized quaternion method and positions in the declared source frame; normalized cycle time makes no velocity claim.
Do not show teeth in continuous hard contact unless contact states are present in the supplied data.
creative_affordances: A clinical diagram, translucent cutaway or sculptural teaching view may be used if data identity, units and limitation labels remain legible.
known_limits: Healthy-participant measurements show translation during initial opening, so the fixed-hinge branch is only a conceptual comparison.
Generic supplied motion does not represent an individual and makes no diagnostic, force or occlusal guarantee.
Authored and source-reviewed draft only; no artifact, renderer or motion dataset was run.

claims.statement: In a digital motion study of 46 adults with healthy temporomandibular-joint function, mandibular translation occurred from the start of opening, including about 2 mm during the first 5 mm; a fixed pure-rotation model is therefore inappropriate as a physiological account of that measured motion.
claims.scope: The cited healthy-participant study and its initial-opening measurements; not every individual or pathological joint.

source_refs.locator: Results: translation during the first 5 mm of opening; Discussion and Conclusions

object_craft.structure: Keep skull, mandible, upper and lower dentition, landmarks, axes and traces as separately selectable source-linked parts.
object_craft.material: Use surface treatments for depth and separation without implying tissue stiffness, disease or contact pressure.
object_craft.articulation: The source pose drives the whole mandible; the fixed-hinge branch is an explicitly separate illustration.

physical_contract.scope: Rigid playback and derived measurement only; no contact, muscle or joint dynamics.
checks: Rigid-landmark distances and rotation-matrix tests pass.
Fixed-hinge overlay cannot overwrite or masquerade as source motion.
